class.name: TweensGdDefinition
class.brief_description: A reusable definition, snapshotted for each playback.
class.description: Create definitions with [code]Tweens.position_2d(...)[/code] or another factory, then start them with [code]Tweens.play(target, definition)[/code]. Changes affect future starts only. Use [method copy] or [code]with_*()[/code] to vary a copy, like C# record [code]with[/code] expressions. With no [member from_value] or [member to_value], the tween uses the value captured at start for that endpoint, before any delay. [codeblock] var move := Tweens.position_2d(Vector2(400, 180), 0.6, Out.CUBIC) await Tweens.play(sprite, move.with_delay(0.2)).end [/codeblock] C# equivalents: immutable definitions in [code]Tweens[/code], mutable [code]TweenDefinition[/code], and [code]TweenOptions[/code]. Timing uses seconds; member names map to snake_case. Vector and Color endpoints accept numeric component Arrays, resolved to the captured type at start. Quaternion factors scale rotation angle; deltas compose rotations.

method.name: copy
method.description: Copies configuration into a new definition. Curves and adapters are copied; Callables and captured Objects remain shared. Subclass fields are not copied automatically. C# immutable definitions use [code]with[/code].

method.name: named
method.description: Creates a definition with a property path, expected target class and value type, endpoint, and timing. Named [code]Tweens[/code] helpers call this factory. Prefer those helpers for ordinary animation.

method.name: validate
method.description: Returns an empty string for valid configuration, or the first error message. Target and property binding checks happen when playback starts.

members.member: Whole-color interpolation space: OKLab=0 (default), sRGB=1, linear RGB=2. Does not change relative RGBA arithmetic.
Premultiplied=0 (default), Straight=1. Input and output remain ordinary straight-alpha Godot Colors.
RGB encoding at the API boundary: sRGB=0 (default), linear RGB=1. Use linear only for APIs that expect linear values.
Prepared value curve used by TweensGdKeyframes. Missing starts are captured per play. Relative endpoints and endpoint adjustments cannot be combined with a keyframe curve.
Custom storage operations, copied for each playback. Use a [TweensGdAdapter] or [member property], not both.
Centered transition width in [code][0, 1][/code]. Defaults to 0.1 (45%–55% at the neutral split); zero directly splices the halves.
How mixed In/Out legs join. Defaults to [code]BlendType.MAKIMA[/code]; matching families keep their conventional shape.
Relative offset instead of [member to_value]. Adds on top of other property changes unless the start is explicit or adjusted. Each repeat adds it again. C# equivalent: [code]By[/code].
Custom progress-to-weight Curve instead of [member ease]. Copied per playback; mutually exclusive with [member ease_function].
Signed gap before the first leg. Positive values wait after capture; negative values overlap or pre-roll.
Added to the by value at start, after [member factor_by]. Null means no adjustment. Requires [member by_value].
Seconds added to [member delay] at start, after [member factor_delay]. May be signed; defaults to zero.
Seconds added to [member duration] at start, after [member factor_duration]. May be signed; defaults to zero.
Added to the from value at start, after [member factor_from]. Null means no adjustment.
Added to the to value at start, after [member factor_to]. Null means no adjustment.
Duration of one leg, in seconds. Defaults to zero; must be finite and nonnegative.
Easing flags, such as [code]In.SINE | Out.CUBIC[/code]. Defaults to linear. [member ease_function] or [member curve] overrides this setting.
Custom progress-to-weight Callable instead of [member ease]. Receives progress and returns weight. Mutually exclusive with [member curve].
Scales the by value once at start: [code]factor_by * by_value + delta_by[/code]. Defaults to 1. Requires [member by_value].
Scales [member delay] once at start: [code]factor_delay * delay + delta_delay[/code]. Defaults to 1; the result must be finite. Negative delays overlap or pre-roll.
Scales [member duration] once at start: [code]factor_duration * duration + delta_duration[/code]. Defaults to 1; the result must be finite and nonnegative.
Scales the from value once at start: [code]factor_from * (from_value or captured value) + delta_from[/code]. Defaults to 1.
Scales the to value once at start: [code]factor_to * (to_value or captured value) + delta_to[/code]. Defaults to 1.

Value behavior during delay and after natural completion. Uses [code]Tweens.Fill[/code]; defaults to RETAIN_FINAL_VALUE. Cancellation does not restore the initial value. A relative tween that follows concurrent property changes removes only its own offset when restoring.
Start value. If the definition has no [member from_value], it uses the value captured at activation, before any positive delay. C# equivalent: [code]From[/code].
Initial value for callback-only definitions that have neither a property nor an adapter. Defaults to 0.0; named value helpers supply their typed zero.
Start this many seconds into the first leg, after the delay. Must not exceed the adjusted duration.
Called once at activation after capture, before any delay fill is applied. Receives the handle.
Called when playback stops early without a fault, such as cancellation or owner exit. Receives the handle.
Called on natural completion, before [member TweensGdHandle.end] resolves. Receives the handle.

Called last when playback ends, including failures. Receives the handle; may be suppressed for invalid targets. Runtime GDScript errors inside Callables are reported by Godot and cannot always be detected by the runner.
Called once when playback reaches its first active update, after the delay. Receives the handle.
Called after each value write, including delay fill. Receives the handle and value.
Hold between the forward and return legs, in seconds. Defaults to zero.
Property or component path on the target, such as [code]^"position:x"[/code]. Cannot cross Objects or traverse nodes. Use this or [member adapter], not both.
Hold between cycles, in seconds. No hold follows the final cycle.
Cycles after the first, or [code]Tweens.INFINITE[/code] (-1). A ping-pong cycle includes both legs. Defaults to zero.
In/Out split in [code][0, 1][/code]. Zero selects Out, 0.5 preserves the balanced pair, and 1 selects In. Applies to paired easing flags.
Skip callbacks after the target or owner becomes invalid. Defaults to false.
Native target class checked at start. An empty StringName disables the class check. Named helpers set it automatically.
End value. If the definition has no [member to_value], it uses the value captured at start. Mutually exclusive with [member by_value]. C# equivalent: [code]To[/code].
Return to the start after each forward leg. Duration applies to each leg; defaults to false.
Captured value type checked at start. TYPE_NIL disables the type check. Named helpers set it automatically.
Independent return split in [code][0, 1][/code]. Zero front-loads the return, 1 rear-loads it; defaults to 0.5, independently of [member skew].
